description: Typical osteoporosis patient. Focus on retrieving P001.

name: Acute Spine Fracture Exercise

description: Osteoporosis patient with acute vertebral compression fracture. Expect P002.

name: Knee Osteoarthritis Flare Up

name: Rheumatoid Arthritis Active Phase
query: My rheumatoid arthritis is active and joints are inflamed. Should I perform heavy weightlifting?
description: Rheumatoid arthritis active phase. Avoid heavy resistance training (weightlifting, expect P021).

name: Acute Gouty Diet Check
query: I am experiencing an acute gout attack. Is it okay to eat red meat or steak?
description: Acute gout attack dietary restriction (avoid purine-rich foods, expect P031).

name: Active Osteomyelitis Infection
query: I have active osteomyelitis bone infection. Can I stand and walk on my leg?
description: Active osteomyelitis infection weight-bearing restriction (expect P041).
